Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$250 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.
8 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.
US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

bottomLine: The desk, the demo and the funding options all check out. The score reflects the paperwork around them.
We scored CanvexOne 4.7 out of 5. The deductions come from the disclosure gaps, not the mechanics. With the US$250 minimum and the demo as guardrails, the risk stays yours to control.
